court: Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

issues.label: Statute of limitations under 28 U.S.C. § 2501
issues.why: The court must determine whether the six-year limitations period bars Mr. Bee's Tucker Act claim.

issues.label: Accrual date of disability retirement claim
issues.why: The court must decide when the claim accrued—at discharge or upon a competent board's action—to assess timeliness.

issues.label: Continuing claim or accrual suspension doctrines
issues.why: Equitable or accrual-related doctrines could affect whether the limitations bar applies.

issues.label: Subject matter jurisdiction over disability retirement pay
issues.why: The court must confirm Tucker Act jurisdiction over a money-mandating disability retirement claim.

issues.label: Standard of review of BCNR decision
issues.why: The court must apply the arbitrary/capricious, unsupported-by-substantial-evidence, or contrary-to-law standard to the Board's decision.

issues.label: Correct legal standard for fitness for duty
issues.why: Mr. Bee contends the BCNR applied the wrong test for assessing whether he was unfit for duty.

issues.label: Liberal consideration under 10 U.S.C. § 1552(h)
issues.why: The court must decide whether liberal consideration was required for PTSD/TBI claims and whether it applied here.

issues.label: Whether failure to state liberal consideration is error
issues.why: The BCNR did not explicitly state it afforded liberal consideration, raising whether silence constitutes reversible error.

issues.label: Effect of promotion and reassignment on fitness
issues.why: Post-injury promotion and instructor duties bear on the fitness determination the court must weigh.

issues.label: Relevance of VA 100% disability rating
issues.why: The court must consider whether the VA's post-discharge rating is probative of unfitness at discharge.

issues.label: Failure to convene medical evaluation board
issues.why: The absence of a pre-discharge medical review board may bear on the propriety of the separation.

issues.label: Voluntary VSP separation versus disability retirement
issues.why: The court must reconcile the voluntary nature of his discharge with his claim to mandatory disability retirement.

issues.label: Standard for judgment on administrative record
issues.why: The court must apply the correct RCFC 52.1 framework for cross-motions on the record.

issues.label: Adequacy of BCNR's stated reasoning
issues.why: The court must assess whether the 2023 Decision provided sufficient explanation to permit meaningful review.

issues.label: Burden of proof before the Board
issues.why: The court must confirm the preponderance-of-evidence standard was correctly allocated and applied.

issues.label: Scope of remedy if error found
issues.why: The court must decide whether to award retirement pay, remand, or order DD-214 correction.
